title: OLEANDER Systems Engineering Design Process v1.0 — Candidate
purpose: Compile OLEANDER's existing zero-base system-definition work into a reusable Systems Engineering professional process covering needs/context, capabilities/functions, information/allocation/interfaces, requirements, logical and physical architecture, integration/V&V, transition and operations/change without making Systems Engineering a super-authority over domain professions.
scope_out: software code quality unless separately assigned
authority_position: Candidate R-E professional-domain process subordinate to OLEANDER Master Runtime, Current zero-base System Definition/Knowledge Architecture, Professional Domain Process Contract, Cross-Disciplinary Integration, project/organizational authority and responsible Systems Engineering owner. Current Architecture Map remains OPEN for Systems Engineering until explicit promotion.

trigger.project_flow_trigger: A material project claim requires system boundary/architecture/requirements/interface/allocation/integration/V&V/configuration/change professional Systems Engineering work.
responsibility_triggers: system architecture or requirements are relied upon across domains
system-level change requires cross-domain impact propagation
trigger.claim_ceiling_rule: The lowest valid ceiling across stakeholder/operational evidence, architecture/requirements baseline, domain-professional interfaces, exact configuration, verification, validation, transition and operational evidence governs.
not_triggered_when: single-domain problem has no material system-level interface/allocation/V&V claim
diagram is presentation-only with no system architecture/requirement authority

knowledge_binding.consequential_knowledge_rule: Consequential stakeholder, system, professional-domain, interface, requirement, V&V, standards and operational knowledge must be admitted through task/claim Operational Mount before supporting SE closure.
standard_code_routes: ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288:2023 or applicable organizational SE process sources
current domain/statutory standards through their responsible owners
precedent_case_routes: bounded system architecture/V&V precedents with explicit context and transfer conditions
practice_routes: OLEANDER zero-base system-definition corpus and project-level Systems Engineering evidence
tool_knowledge_routes: current modelling/requirements/simulation/test/configuration tools when used; tools do not own professional authority

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: System-of-Interest / Need / Capability / Authority Decision Register
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Define system boundary, stakeholder need, operational context, capabilities and decision authority without making Systems Engineering a super-authority over domain professions.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Current system definition chain + stakeholder/operational evidence + domain owner authority.
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Retain only with explicit boundary/authority and domain ownership; SE may integrate/trace but cannot waive owner-native professional authority.
failure_or_hold_conditions: SE assigns professional PASS to domain
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent SE review challenges boundary, need/capability trace and authority allocation.

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: Assumption / Decision / Risk / Trade-study Uncertainty Register
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Keep system assumptions, decisions, constraints, risks and uncertainty explicit with source, consequence and closure route.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Controlled system-definition sources + domain inputs + operational evidence.
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: No assumption may become requirement/interface fact by repetition; consequential unknowns remain linked to affected architecture/V&V.
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent SE review samples high-impact unresolved assumptions and decisions.

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: Logical / Allocation / Interface Architecture Alternative Trade Set
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Compare materially different logical architectures, allocations, interfaces and physical realization strategies under common needs/requirements.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Controlled needs/requirements/functions/interfaces + alternative architecture models/trade evidence.
practitioner_object_contracts.revision_identity: option_id + common requirements/architecture baseline + option revision
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Weighted score alone cannot select architecture; hard constraints, domain authority and sensitivity remain visible.
failure_or_hold_conditions: cosmetic allocation variants counted as alternatives
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent SE review challenges trade assumptions and strongest rejected architecture.

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: Controlled Requirements / Logical / Physical Architecture Baseline
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Carry the actual system architecture through controlled capabilities, functions, states, information, allocations, requirements, interfaces, logical and physical architecture.
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Baseline components must be mutually traceable; diagrams/reports cannot substitute for controlled requirements/interface/configuration sources.
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent SE review on exact baseline, preserving domain-owner boundaries.

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: Requirements / Interface / Configuration Baseline Release Register
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Control when requirements, interfaces and configuration baselines may be relied upon by domain teams and integration/V&V.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Current requirements/interface/configuration artifacts + authorized change/approval evidence.
practitioner_object_contracts.decision_owner: Systems Engineering professional owner / Configuration authority per governance
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Release does not grant domain professional PASS; unresolved conditions and interface maturity remain explicit.
failure_or_hold_conditions: baseline released with unresolved controlling conflict
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent/configuration review where governance requires before baseline retention.

practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Bind integrated configuration, interface versions, test conditions, anomalies and regression evidence to exact system baseline.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Actual integrated system/configuration + controlled interface/V&V procedures + observed test evidence.
practitioner_object_contracts.decision_owner: Systems Engineering professional owner / V&V owner per plan
practitioner_object_contracts.revision_identity: record_id + exact integrated configuration + procedure revision + date
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Verification applies only to exact configuration/method; workaround/fix must propagate to baseline and regression scope.
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent V&V review when required by assurance/risk; keep verification distinct from validation.

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: Validation / Transition / Operations / Support / Retirement Register
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Carry stakeholder-context validation, transition, operational discrepancies, support changes and retirement consequences against the accepted system configuration.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Validated operational scenarios + accepted transition/operations/support/retirement evidence.
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Validation result is scenario/context/configuration bounded; transition or operations discrepancies reopen affected requirements/architecture/V&V.
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent validation review where material; stakeholder/domain authority remains explicit.

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: Independent Systems Engineering Architecture / Requirements / V&V Review Record
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Independently challenge requirement quality/trace, architecture completeness, interface ownership, configuration identity and V&V logic without overriding domain professions.
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Review stales when affected requirement/architecture/interface/configuration changes; cannot substitute for domain professional review.
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Reviewer independence proportionate to system consequence and governance; domain specialist review remains separate.

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: System Change / Configuration / Impact / Re-V&V Ledger
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Propagate system changes to needs, requirements, functions, architecture, interfaces, domain allocations, configuration and V&V without blanket reset or silent staleness.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Authorized change/anomaly/operational event + full trace/dependency graph.
practitioner_object_contracts.decision_owner: Systems Engineering professional owner / Configuration authority
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Change closes only after affected baseline, domain handoffs and re-verification/revalidation scope are updated or explicitly retained with evidence.
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent re-review where change affects prior architecture/V&V decision basis.

assurance.professional_review: Systems Engineering professional review at the declared system/baseline/V&V claim ceiling, preserving system boundary, requirement trace, configuration identity and domain-authority boundaries.
assurance.evidence_review: Verify stakeholder/source trace, requirement/architecture/interface/configuration evidence and exact V&V evidence against the claimed system state.
assurance.independent_review: Distinct review is required when risk, system criticality, architecture baseline, V&V claim or organizational process requires it; producer self-review cannot replace domain-professional or V&V authority.

stale_scope_rules: only affected system/requirements/architecture/interface/configuration/V&V objects/reviews become stale unless dependency analysis shows wider consequence
upstream_impact_rules: changed stakeholder/context/domain authority reopens consuming system requirements/architecture/V&V
interface_reopen_rules: material shared-variable/interface changes reopen affected Cross-Disciplinary Integration interfaces
receipt_stale_rules: Systems Engineering receipt becomes stale at affected scope when governing requirement/architecture/configuration/V&V evidence changes

process_exit_conditions: applicable SE stage work complete at declared claim ceiling
required controlled/native outputs and readback exist
verification and validation evidence remain separately current where claimed
open_items_allowed: explicit later/outside-claim domain, implementation, V&V, operational or retirement items that do not contradict current SE verdict
completion_contract.promotion_effect: Candidate only: no promotion effect. If later adopted Current, a bounded PASS may satisfy only the Systems Engineering professional-process dependency and cannot grant domain-professional PASS, Design KEEP or Project Promotion.
